## Release Notes

### Features

- add a trash button to task rows
- settings page with light and dark theme

## Install ray-task 0.2.0

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/carvalhosauro/ray-task/releases/download/v0.2.0/ray-task-installer.sh | sh
```
